text:
Over the last 13 weeks, Northstar Health – Commercial paid 64.6% of Lacrivia claims, against 81.5% nationally. That is about 17 points lower. Lacrivia's market share in the plan is 23.7%, the same as its national share of 23.7%. It is about 2.5 points below the national commercial channel (26.2%).

**Last 13 weeks (weeks ending 3 Jul – 25 Sep 2026)**

| Metric | Northstar – Commercial (PL1001) | National (all channels) | National commercial channel |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paid rate (paid ÷ (paid + rejected)) | **64.6%** (455 / 704) | **81.5%** (10,442 / 12,809) | 82.3% (5,649 / 6,865) |
| Prior-auth rejections as a share of claims | 32.0% (225 / 704) | 10.7% (1,372 / 12,809) | 10.6% (728 / 6,865) |
| Lacrivia share of dry-eye prescriptions | **23.7%** (455 / 1,916) | **23.7%** (10,442 / 43,975) | 26.2% (5,649 / 21,530) |

**What this means**
- **Prior authorization is the main barrier.** It caused 225 of the plan's 249 rejected Lacrivia claims (90%). Other reasons are minor: coverage 3, plan limits 2, early refill 15, pharmacy network 1, other 3.
- **This has been going on all year.** The plan's weekly paid rate has stayed at about 60–65% since January. There's no sign of a recent policy change.
- **Share is holding up despite the rejections.** Prescription counts are paid claims only (Lacrivia's prescriptions equal its paid claims in every plan and channel). So the plan matches national share even though a third of its claims are rejected for prior authorization. However, it still trails the national commercial average by about 2.5 points.
- **The same payer's other commercial plan does much better.** Northstar Health – Commercial East (PL1039) is run by the same pharmacy benefit manager (OptiScript). There, 92.7% of Lacrivia claims were paid (332 / 358) and share was 27.5%. That suggests a plan-specific prior-authorization policy on PL1001 worth raising with Northstar or OptiScript.

**Checks on the paid rate**
- Counting reversed claims (claims paid then reversed, all flagged as abandoned) in the base: 64.4% for the plan vs 80.0% nationally.
- Removing cash claims, which are never rejected, from the national figure: 80.6%.
- The gap stays at about 16–17 points either way.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Plan:** Northstar Health – Commercial is plan PL1001 in the payer reference table (CORE.PAYER_SPINE). Commercial East (PL1039) is kept separate because it is a different plan.
- **Lacrivia:** both of its product codes (NDCs) in the product master (CORE.PRODUCT).
- **Paid rate:** from the claims table (RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ). Status P = paid, R = rejected, V = reversed. Reject codes were grouped into reasons using REF.REJ_CODE. Claims are dated 27 Jun – 25 Sep 2026. Claims from 26–30 Sep fall in an incomplete week and are left out.
- **Market share:** Lacrivia prescriptions ÷ all prescriptions in the dry-eye market, as defined in BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER. Data is the weekly prescription table (RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY). The 13 weeks run Saturday to Friday, ending 25 Sep 2026.
- **Cross-check:** national share by channel matches the reporting table MART.PYR_SHR_WK exactly.
- **"National"** means all plans and channels, including cash, unless labelled commercial channel.
- **Data use:** I used only plan- and channel-level totals. No prescriber- or patient-level data or sandbox tables were used, which suits a market access request.

sql.sql: SELECT p.*, d.MKT_DEF, d.EFF_FROM, d.EFF_TO, d.SRC_FILE FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p FULL OUTER JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER d ON p.PROD_NDC11=d.PROD_NDC11 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'CHNL' t, OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::string v FROM PHARMA_DEMO.REF.CHNL UNION ALL SELECT 'REJ', OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::string FROM PHARMA_DEMO.REF.REJ_CODE UNION ALL SELECT 'TIER', OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::string FROM PHARMA_DEMO.REF.CVG_TIER

SELECT ADJ_STAT, PAT_TYP, SEC_PYR_FLG, ABNDN_FLG, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT CLM_ID) dist, MIN(CLM_DT), MAX(CLM_DT), SUM(IFF(REJ_RSN_CD IS NULL,1,0)) null_rej, SUM(IFF(SUBST_NDC11 IS NOT NULL,1,0)) subst FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT CLM_ID) d, COUNT(DISTINCT PROD_NDC11) ndcs, SUM(IFF(PLAN_ID NOT IN (SELECT PLAN_ID FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PAYER_SPINE),1,0)) unmapped_plan, SUM(IFF(PROD_NDC11 NOT IN (SELECT PROD_NDC11 FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT),1,0)) unmapped_ndc FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ
SELECT WK_END_DT, DAYNAME(WK_END_DT) dn, COUNT(*) n, SUM(TRX_QTY) trx, COUNT(DISTINCT PLAN_ID) plans FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT r.CHNL_CD rx_ch, s.CHNL_CD spine_ch, COUNT(*) n, SUM(TRX_QTY) trx, SUM(IFF(TRX_QTY<0,1,0)) neg, SUM(IFF(r.PLAN_ID IS NULL,1,0)) nullplan FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PAYER_SPINE s ON r.PLAN_ID=s.PLAN_ID GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT WK_END_DT, PRSCRBR_ME, PROD_NDC11, PLAN_ID, CHNL_CD) d FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY
SELECT * FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PAYER_SPINE WHERE PLAN_NM ILIKE '%northstar%' OR PAYER_NM ILIKE '%northstar%' OR PAYER_ID='PY100'
SELECT PAYER_NM, COUNT(*) FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PAYER_SPINE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN c.PLAN_ID='PL1001' THEN 'PL1001' WHEN c.PLAN_ID='PL1039' THEN 'PL1039' ELSE 'OTHER' END seg, s.CHNL_CD='C' is_comm,
 SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='P',1,0)) paid, SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='R',1,0)) rej, SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='V',1,0)) rev,
 SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='P' AND SEC_PYR_FLG='N',1,0)) paid_prim, SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='R' AND SEC_PYR_FLG='N',1,0)) rej_prim, SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='V' AND SEC_PYR_FLG='N',1,0)) rev_prim
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ c JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON c.PROD_NDC11=p.PROD_NDC11 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PAYER_SPINE s ON c.PLAN_ID=s.PLAN_ID
WHERE p.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND c.CLM_DT BETWEEN '2026-06-27' AND '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT CASE WHEN r.PLAN_ID='PL1001' THEN 'PL1001' WHEN r.PLAN_ID='PL1039' THEN 'PL1039' ELSE 'OTHER' END seg, r.CHNL_CD,
 SUM(IFF(p.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA',TRX_QTY,0)) lac_trx, SUM(TRX_QTY) mkt_trx, SUM(IFF(p.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA',NRX_QTY,0)) lac_nrx, SUM(NRX_QTY) mkt_nrx
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON r.PROD_NDC11=p.PROD_NDC11
JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER d ON r.PROD_NDC11=d.PROD_NDC11 AND d.MKT_DEF='DRY_EYE' AND r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN d.EFF_FROM AND d.EFF_TO
WHERE r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-03' AND '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT IFF(c.PLAN_ID='PL1001','PL1001','NATIONAL_ALL') seg, s.CHNL_CD, COALESCE(j.REJ_GRP, c.REJ_RSN_CD) grp, ADJ_STAT, COUNT(*) n
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ c JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON c.PROD_NDC11=p.PROD_NDC11 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PAYER_SPINE s ON c.PLAN_ID=s.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.REF.REJ_CODE j ON c.REJ_RSN_CD=j.REJ_RSN_CD
WHERE p.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND c.CLM_DT BETWEEN '2026-06-27' AND '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT DATEADD(day, MOD(6 - DAYOFWEEKISO(CLM_DT) + 7 - 1, 7) , CLM_DT) wk_end_guess, DAYNAME(CLM_DT) dn,
 SUM(IFF(c.PLAN_ID='PL1001' AND ADJ_STAT='P',1,0)) nsc_p, SUM(IFF(c.PLAN_ID='PL1001' AND ADJ_STAT='R',1,0)) nsc_r,
 SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='P',1,0)) nat_p, SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='R',1,0)) nat_r
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ c JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON c.PROD_NDC11=p.PROD_NDC11
WHERE p.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND c.CLM_DT >= '2026-03-28'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 5

SELECT DATEADD(day,4,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATEADD(day,2,CLM_DT))) wk_end,
 SUM(IFF(c.PLAN_ID='PL1001' AND ADJ_STAT='P',1,0)) nsc_p, SUM(IFF(c.PLAN_ID='PL1001' AND ADJ_STAT='R',1,0)) nsc_r,
 SUM(IFF(c.PLAN_ID='PL1001' AND ADJ_STAT='R' AND REJ_RSN_CD IN ('75','3N','PA'),1,0)) nsc_pa,
 SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='P',1,0)) nat_p, SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='R',1,0)) nat_r
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ c JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON c.PROD_NDC11=p.PROD_NDC11
WHERE p.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND c.CLM_DT >= '2026-01-03'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CHNL_CD, MKT_DEF, SUM(BRAND_TRX) b, SUM(MKT_TRX) m, COUNT(DISTINCT WK_END_DT) wks FROM PHARMA_DEMO.MART.PYR_SHR_WK WHERE BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND WK_END_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-03' AND '2026-09-25' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
